name: spellkave_eval
label: Evaluate DSL Expression
description: Evaluate a Spellkave DSL expression offline using the wasm-compiled resolution evaluator. Accepts expression source, kind (predicate, int, or text), author-supplied facts grouped by subject or pool, and die faces in draw order. Returns the result value with its type, draws used, and evaluation trace, or a named rejection naming the cause.

expression.description: DSL source text to evaluate offline.

facts.description: The values the expression reads, grouped by subject (actor, target, location, session, world, actor.wielded_item, equipped items, bindings, event), plus roll_tables, item_sources, roll_modifier_bias, event_kind, occupants_at, peers_near_target, channel_pools. Validated strictly in Rust.

dice.description: Die faces in draw order consumed by stochastic roll operators and roll tables.

promptSnippet: Evaluate a DSL expression offline with traced execution and fixed dice
promptGuidelines: spellkave_eval: evaluate offline; no running node or connection needed.
spellkave_eval: false predicate returns ok=true with value={type:'Bool', value:false}; check errors and bounds reject with ok=false.

examples.description: evaluate an attack roll offline against supplied stats
evaluate a damage roll offline with fixed dice
